description: Defines the base class ExtractorFuzzerBase for media extractor fuzzing, including methods for setting data sources, extracting tracks, and managing buffers, along with an internal BufferSource class.

classes.name: ExtractorFuzzerBase
classes.description: Base class for media extractor fuzzing, providing interface for creating extractors, setting data sources, and processing media tracks.

classes.name: BufferSource
classes.description: Inner class inheriting from DataSource, managing buffer data for media extraction.

methods.name: createExtractor
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create the media extractor component, to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source for media extraction.

methods.name: setDataSourceFlags
methods.description: Sets flags for the data source.

methods.name: extractTrack
methods.description: Virtual method to extract a specific media track.

methods.name: seekAndExtractTrack
methods.description: Virtual method to seek and extract a specific media track with duration.
